chunks.quote: THE SYSTEM FREEZES UP COMPLETELY CAUSING EVERYTHING NOT WORK RADIO BACK UP CAMERA ETC.

questions.question: Which fuel pump recall affects a vehicle whose owner complains about filling the fuel tank?

chunks.quote: WHEN FILLING MY TANK, AUTO-SHUTOFF HAPPENS WHEN THE TANK IS AT LEAST 2 GALLONS SHY OF BEING FULL.

questions.note: The Rogue owner of complaint 11032133 complains about the gas gauge, not filling, and the Rogue has no fuel pump recall.

questions.question: The owner in complaint 10825467 asks about the piston snap ring recall that has no fix yet. What will dealers do under that recall's remedy?

expected.text: Inspect and replace the piston assemblies and damaged engine components as necessary, free of charge.

chunks.quote: CONTACTED AMERICAN HONDA TODAY IN REGARDS TO PISTON SNAP RING RECALL.
dealers will inspect and replace the piston assemblies and damaged engine components, as necessary, free of charge.

questions.note: Two documents: the complaint names the recall only by its part; the recall text 16V074000 gives the remedy.

questions.question: The owner in complaint 10824361 was sold a 2016 Honda Civic the day after a recall and stop of sale. What defect does the engine recall for that vehicle describe?

expected.text: Piston assemblies that may have been made without a piston wrist pin circlip, or with the circlip installed incorrectly, in 2.0L engines.

chunks.quote: I WAS SOLD A BRAND NEW 2016 HONDA CIVIC THE DAY AFTER A RECALL AND STOP OF SALE WAS ISSUED.
The affected vehicles have engines with piston assemblies that may have been manufactured without a piston wrist pin circlip or with an incorrectly installed piston wrist pin circlip.

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with a cracked windshield?

chunks.quote: WINDSHIELD CRACK APPEARED OVERNIGHT ON THE 4TH DAY OF OWNERSHIP.
WINDSHIELD SPONTANEOUSLY CRACKED AT THE BASE OF THE WINDSHIELD

questions.note: Recall texts name other cracks (the engine block heater of 26V011000, the seat weight sensor of 26V332000, the suspension arms of 20V286000, the engine castings of 20V064000); none is a windshield or an owner's report.

questions.question: Which vehicles do owners report with a transmission that switched to reverse on its own?

chunks.quote: These vehicles were previously recalled and repaired under recalls 15V-246, 16V-643 or 17V-210, however the repair may not have been completed properly.

questions.question: Which of the two Subaru fuel pump recalls also covers Toyota 86 vehicles?

chunks.quote: 2018-2019 BRZ, WRX, and Toyota 86 vehicles.

questions.note: 20V218000 covers 2019 Impreza, Outback, Legacy and Ascent vehicles only.

questions.note: Negated repairs do not count: 10667633 and 10691672 ("THE VEHICLE WAS NOT REPAIRED"), 10957753 and 11205702 ("NOT DIAGNOSED OR REPAIRED"), 10689793 ("NO REPAIRS NEEDED OR MADE").

questions.question: Which vehicles did owners report being in a rear-end collision?

questions.question: Which recall campaigns were received by NHTSA in 2020?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r WHERE year(strptime(ReportReceivedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')) = 2020
questions.note: Recall dates are day/month/year in recalls.json ('24/06/2015'), complaint dates month/day/year.

questions.question: Which recall campaigns carry an NHTSA action number?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r WHERE NHTSAActionNumber IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Which complaints were filed in 2017?
questions.sql: SELECT odiNumber FROM complaints WHERE year(strptime(dateComplaintFiled, '%m/%d/%Y')) = 2017

questions.question: Which complaints about the 2016 Honda Civic list the engine among their components?
questions.sql: SELECT odiNumber FROM complaints WHERE product.productModel = 'CIVIC' AND components LIKE '%ENGINE%'

questions.question: Which recall campaigns concern air bags?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r WHERE Component LIKE 'AIR BAGS%'

questions.question: Which complaints were filed more than 30 days after the incident?
questions.sql: SELECT odiNumber FROM complaints WHERE strptime(dateComplaintFiled, '%m/%d/%Y') - strptime(dateOfIncident, '%m/%d/%Y') > INTERVAL 30 DAY

questions.question: Which recall campaigns affecting the 2015 Ford Escape were received after 2020?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r WHERE Model = 'ESCAPE' AND year(strptime(ReportReceivedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')) > 2020

questions.question: Which complaints about the 2019 Subaru Outback list the electrical system among their components?
questions.sql: SELECT odiNumber FROM complaints WHERE product.productModel = 'OUTBACK' AND components LIKE '%ELECTRICAL SYSTEM%'

questions.question: Which fuel pump recall campaigns were received before 2021?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r WHERE Component LIKE '%FUEL PUMP%' AND year(strptime(ReportReceivedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')) < 2021

questions.question: Which recall campaigns affecting the 2019 Toyota RAV4 were filed by Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r WHERE Model = 'RAV4' AND Manufacturer = 'Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing'
questions.note: Two other RAV4 recalls come from distributors (Gulf States Toyota, Southeast Toyota Distributors).

questions.question: How many recall campaigns are in the data?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT count(*) FROM r

questions.question: How many injuries do the complaints report in total?
questions.sql: SELECT sum(numberOfInjuries) FROM complaints

questions.question: How many recall campaigns affect the 2017 Nissan Rogue?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE Model = 'ROGUE'

questions.question: Which vehicle is affected by the fewest recall campaigns in the data?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT Model FROM r GROUP BY Model ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1
questions.note: Outback 3; Civic and Rogue 5 each.

questions.question: In which year did NHTSA receive the most of these recall campaigns?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT year(strptime(ReportReceivedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')) FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many complaints report a fire?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM complaints WHERE fire
questions.note: None does.

questions.question: Which recall component appears in the most recall campaigns?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT Component FROM r GROUP BY Component ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: The component as NHTSA writes it; four campaigns, the next ones have two.

questions.question: Which manufacturer filed the most recall campaigns?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT Manufacturer FROM r GROUP BY Manufacturer ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.note: The recall's own Manufacturer field.

questions.question: How many complaints were filed in 2019?
questions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM complaints WHERE year(strptime(dateComplaintFiled, '%m/%d/%Y')) = 2019
questions.note: Complaint 11123359 about a 2019 Outback was filed in 2018.

questions.question: How many recall campaigns affecting the 2016 Honda Civic were received after 2016?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT count(*) FROM r WHERE Model = 'CIVIC' AND year(strptime(ReportReceivedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')) > 2016

questions.question: Which recall campaigns affect the vehicle of complaint 11010220?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT r.NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r JOIN complaints c ON c.product.productModel = r.Model WHERE c.odiNumber = 11010220

questions.question: Which recall campaigns affect a vehicle whose owner reports a crash?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT DISTINCT r.NHTSACampaignNumber FROM r JOIN complaints c ON c.product.productModel = r.Model WHERE c.crash
questions.note: Crash complaints concern the Escape and the Rogue.

questions.question: Which make is the vehicle of complaint 11209676?
questions.sql: SELECT v.make FROM complaints c JOIN vehicles v ON v.model = c.product.productModel WHERE c.odiNumber = 11209676

questions.question: How many recall campaigns affect the vehicle of complaint 10957753?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT count(*) FROM r JOIN complaints c ON c.product.productModel = r.Model WHERE c.odiNumber = 10957753

questions.question: Which complaints concern a vehicle that has an air bag recall?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT DISTINCT c.odiNumber FROM complaints c JOIN r ON r.Model = c.product.productModel WHERE r.Component LIKE 'AIR BAGS%'
questions.note: Air bag recalls affect the Rogue and the Civic.

questions.question: Which complaints concern a vehicle that has a recall campaign with an NHTSA action number?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT DISTINCT c.odiNumber FROM complaints c JOIN r ON r.Model = c.product.productModel WHERE r.NHTSAActionNumber IS NOT NULL

questions.question: What model year is the vehicle affected by recall 19V493000?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT v.model_year FROM r JOIN vehicles v ON v.model = r.Model WHERE r.NHTSACampaignNumber = '19V493000'

questions.question: Which vehicle manufacturers have a vehicle with a fuel pump recall?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT DISTINCT v.manufacturer FROM r JOIN vehicles v ON v.model = r.Model WHERE r.Component LIKE '%FUEL PUMP%'
questions.note: The vehicle record's manufacturer, not the recall's.

questions.question: Which vehicles have both an owner complaint filed in 2019 and a recall campaign received in 2019?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT DISTINCT r.Model FROM r JOIN complaints c ON c.product.productModel = r.Model WHERE year(strptime(ReportReceivedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')) = 2019 AND year(strptime(dateComplaintFiled, '%m/%d/%Y')) = 2019

questions.question: Which complaints concern the vehicle affected by recall 21V839000?
questions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT unnest(results, recursive := true) FROM recalls) SELECT c.odiNumber FROM complaints c JOIN r ON r.Model = c.product.productModel WHERE r.NHTSACampaignNumber = '21V839000'
